Tata Sierra EV Battery Pack Power Output Explained

Tata Motors has clarified the differing power outputs between the smaller and larger battery packs of its upcoming Sierra EV. The company explained that the smaller battery pack is designed to deliver more power, while the larger one prioritizes range. This decision is aimed at optimizing performance and user experience for different needs.
